agent_assessment:
The core implementation is solid and comprehensive. All 6 settings are fully implemented across proto (field numbers 25-30), Go structs, normalization, proto mapping, and UI type definitions. Execution enforcement is complete: concurrency gate in startLocked() with errAtCapacity sentinel, queue depth enforcement in QueueBacklog(), circuit breaker with .vrooli/circuit-breaker.json persistence (RecordFailure/RecordSuccess/Reset/IsBroken/BrokenItems), cost cap estimation ($0.10/turn * maxTurns), and explicit circuit breaker reset endpoint (POST /api/v1/execution/circuit-breaker/reset). The background poller drains pending items via drainPendingLocked() respecting concurrency limits. CLI circuit-breaker-reset command is implemented. Settings UI ExecutionTab has all 6 controls. Build compiles cleanly and all tests pass.

Two UI integration gaps remain: (1) AgentsDropdown has maxConcurrent prop but it's never passed from GraphWorkspaceHUD or SidebarHeader, so the N/M badge never renders in practice. (2) Circuit-broken visual indicators are completely absent from the UI - no styling, badges, or status markers for circuit-broken items in sidebar or graph nodes, despite the API returning CircuitBrokenItems in governance status.

Test gap: settings normalization tests only cover theme field. The 6 new clamping rules (e.g., maxConcurrentExecutions clamped 1-20) have no dedicated normalization tests.
notes: AgentsDropdown maxConcurrent prop exists but is never wired from parent components (GraphWorkspaceHUD, SidebarHeader) - N/M badge is dead code
No circuit-broken visual indicators in UI despite API support via GovernanceStatusResponse.CircuitBrokenItems
Settings normalization tests missing for all 6 new fields (only theme normalization is tested)
ProcessScheduledStarts() was renamed to ProcessActiveExecutions() + drainPendingLocked() rather than ProcessPendingStarts() as planned - functionally equivalent, naming is fine
Build compiles cleanly, all existing and new tests pass (execution: 0.527s, settings: 0.088s)

evidence.title: Go build verification
evidence.description: go build ./... completes with zero errors for swarm-manager API

evidence.title: Test suite passes
evidence.description: go test ./internal/execution/ ./internal/settings/ passes all tests (execution: 0.527s, settings: 0.088s)

evidence.title: Settings proto fields 25-30 present
evidence.description: All 6 settings defined in settings.proto with correct field numbers (25-30), buf.validate constraints matching plan ranges, and corresponding API proto optional fields

evidence.title: Go settings struct complete
evidence.description: Settings struct in model.go has all 6 fields, DefaultSettings() returns correct defaults (3, 50, 3, 60, 0, 0.10), normalizeSettings() clamps all 6 fields, settingsToProto()/settingsPatchFromProto() handle all fields

evidence.title: Concurrency enforcement in startLocked()
evidence.description: service_control.go gates startLocked() with countActiveExecutions() check against MaxConcurrentExecutions, returning errAtCapacity sentinel. countActiveExecutions() counts only StatusStarting + StatusRunning as specified. TestConcurrencyGate_StartLocked covers this.

evidence.title: Queue depth enforcement in QueueBacklog()
evidence.description: service_queue.go checks countQueuedExecutions() against MaxQueueDepth before record creation, returns HTTP 409 when exceeded. TestQueueDepthEnforcement covers this.

evidence.title: Yolo at-capacity leaves pending
evidence.description: service_queue.go yolo path catches errAtCapacity and leaves record as StatusPending instead of rolling back. TestYoloAtCapacity_LeavesPending covers this.

evidence.title: Circuit breaker implementation
evidence.description: circuit_breaker.go (179 lines) manages .vrooli/circuit-breaker.json with RecordFailure/RecordSuccess/Reset/IsBroken/BrokenItems. Uses storage.WriteJSONAtomic(). Tests cover threshold tripping, success clearing, explicit reset, cooldown expiry, and broken item listing.

evidence.title: Circuit breaker reset endpoint
evidence.description: POST /api/v1/execution/circuit-breaker/reset registered in handler.go, handled in handler_lifecycle.go. Accepts {"item": "kind/name"}, returns 200 with {"ok":true} or 404.

evidence.title: Cost cap enforcement
evidence.description: service_queue.go checks costPerTurnEstimate * agentMaxTurns against executionCostCapPerRun. Returns HTTP 409 if exceeded unless force=true. TestCostCapEnforcement covers default case ($0.10 * 60 = $6.00 vs $2.00 cap).

evidence.title: Pending drain in background poller
evidence.description: polling.go ProcessActiveExecutions() calls drainPendingLocked() which sorts pending by CreatedAt, checks concurrency before each start, stops at capacity. Scheduled starts processed first (priority over pending).

evidence.title: Governance status in overview
evidence.description: GovernanceStatus() in governance.go returns ActiveExecutions, MaxConcurrent, QueueDepth, MaxQueueDepth, CircuitBrokenItems, EstimatedQueuedCost. Wired into OverviewResponse via GovernanceProvider interface.

evidence.title: CLI circuit-breaker-reset command
evidence.description: cmd_execution.go cmdCircuitBreakerReset (lines 428-446) registered in app.go. Accepts --item flag, posts to /execution/circuit-breaker/reset.

evidence.title: Settings UI ExecutionTab
evidence.description: ExecutionTab.tsx renders all 6 governance settings with inputs, validation (clamped ranges), and reset buttons. TypeScript types in settings.ts match Go struct.

evidence.title: GAP: AgentsDropdown maxConcurrent not wired
evidence.description: AgentsDropdown.tsx accepts maxConcurrent prop and renders N/M label (line 41), but neither GraphWorkspaceHUD.tsx nor SidebarHeader.tsx passes this prop. The badge format works but is unreachable in production.

evidence.title: GAP: No circuit-broken UI indicators
evidence.description: No references to circuitBroken or circuit-broken in UI component files. The API returns CircuitBrokenItems in governance status but no UI component consumes this data for visual indicators in sidebar or graph nodes.

evidence.title: GAP: Missing settings normalization tests
evidence.description: normalize_test.go only has TestNormalizeSettingsDefaultsTheme. No tests validate clamping for the 6 new fields (e.g., maxConcurrentExecutions outside 1-20 gets clamped).

improvement_suggestions.description: Add normalization tests for all 6 governance settings in normalize_test.go: test below-min clamping, above-max clamping, and boundary values for each field
Add browser-automation-studio capture config for the Settings page ExecutionTab so GCT visual dimension can verify settings UI rendering
